_provenance: CropAtlas method parameters. These are the BLOCK-SIDE classification bands and the overall combination rule. They are CropAtlas rule-based planning defaults, NOT calibrated per-block science and NOT validated against a yield outcome. Crop-side requirements live in crop-requirements.json and come from the source-cited agronomy reference; this file only describes how an observed block is classified so the two can be compared. Adjusting these bands changes displayed compatibility labels only — no data is modified and no probability is produced.
_water_balance_note: LIVE forecast rainfall minus reference crop evapotranspiration (ET0) summed over the first N served forecast days. Null unless every day in the window is present; never zero-filled.

block_water_supply_bands._note: Classified from the live 7-day water balance (mm). Higher = more surplus water available to the crop.

_dry_run_note: When the first N forecast days contain at least this many days below 1.0 mm, the supply class is stepped one band drier. Mirrors the frozen FIELD_HIGH dry-day rule.

water_compatibility_ordinal_step._note: Compatibility of the crop's water_need_class against the block's supply class, keyed on (supply ordinal - crop need ordinal).

_season_note: Days before / after the reference sowing-transplanting window that still count as 'approaching' or 'recently closed'. Calendar-based, so it says nothing about the weather during the season.
_growing_window_note: How far the reference growing-window length (duration_days) may differ from the reference climate-record length before the growing-season climate component reports insufficient data rather than a partial comparison.

overall_label_bands._note: Applied to the mean of the AVAILABLE component scores only. Never applied when fewer than min_components are available.

_min_components_note: Fewer available components than this yields 'insufficient_data' rather than a thin label. A single passing component is never enough to call a block a strong match.

confidence_bands._note: Data-confidence label from how much supporting data was actually available for the assessment.

excluded_dimensions: crop_temperature_range (not stated in the repository crop reference)
crop_soil_ph_range (not stated in the repository crop reference)
